title: 1 Enoch 79 — Uriel's closing summary of the astronomical revelation

translation.sourceText: 1 Enoch Astronomical Book (Book of the Luminaries / Sefer ha-Mazzalot) — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Aramaic DSS 4Q208-4Q211, OLDEST surviving Enoch material late 3rd c. BCE, primary where preserved; Ge'ez Charles 1912 PD + Knibb 1978 fallback). No Greek witness — Akhmim Panopolitanus covers chs 1-32 only.

paragraphs.text: ወይእዜሰ፡ ወልድየ፡ አርአይኩከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወተፈጸመ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ለሰማይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəʾəzē-sa waldəya ʾarʾayku-ka kwəlo wa-tafaṣṣama ḫolaqomu la-kwəlu la-kawākəbt la-samāy

i18n.en: And now, my son, I have shown you everything; and the reckoning of all the stars of heaven is completed.

paragraphs.text: ወአርአይኩከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሕገገ፡ ለበበ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወለበበ፡ ሕግ፡ ወለበበ፡ ኵሉ፡ መንግሥት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾarʾayku-ka kwəlo ḥəgaga laba-mawāʿəl wa-laba-ḥəg wa-laba-kwəlu mangəśt

i18n.en: And I have shown you all the laws for every day, and for every law, and for every dominion.

paragraphs.text: ወዘንተ፡ ውእቱ፡ ሕጉ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ዘያመጽእ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለበበ፡ ሐጋ፡ ለበበ፡ ቀዋምቱ፡ ለመንግሥቱ፡ በፍኖት፡ ቀዋሚ፡ ዘኮነ፡ ይትፌጸም፡ በበ፡ ወርኆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-zanta wəʾətu ḥəggu la-warḫ zayāmaṣṣəʾ ḫolaqomu laba-ḥaggā laba-qawāmtu la-mangəśtu ba-fənot qawāmi zakona yətfēṣam baba warḫomu

i18n.en: And this is the law of the moon, which brings their reckoning according to her festivals, according to her stations of dominion in the appointed path which is completed month by month.

paragraphs.text: ወሕገገ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ምስለ፡ መንበራቲሁ፡ ወምሥራቅ፡ ወምዕራብ፡ ስብአ፡ ዘያስተራኩም፡ ኆለቆ፡ ዘኵሉ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለፀሐይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ḥəgaga la-ḍaḥay məsla manbarātihu wa-məśrāq wa-məʿrāb səbʾa zayāstarākum ḫolaqo zakwəlu mangəśtu la-ḍaḥay

i18n.en: And the laws of the sun, with its stations and east and west: seven that order the reckoning of all the sun's dominion.

paragraphs.text: ወዝ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ነዊኅ፡ ይነግሕ፡ ወምዕራብ፡ ሐጺር፡ ይነግሕ፡ ወይትገብእ፡ መንበሮሙ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ዘሕገገ፡ ዘይትኬለል፡ ኮነ፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-zə məśrāq nawiḫ yənaggəḥ wa-məʿrāb ḥaṣir yənaggəḥ wa-yətgabbəʾ manbaromu la-ḍaḥay zaḥəgaga zayətkēlal kona laba-gizēhu

i18n.en: And this east shines long and this west shines short; and the sun's stations return — those of the law which is encompassed in its proper time.

paragraphs.text: እሉ፡ መርሕተ፡ መዋዕልት፡ ኮኑ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለሕገገ፡ ብርሃናት፡ ዘአርአየኒ፡ ኦሪኤል፡ ዘውእቱ፡ መርሐ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəllu marḥata mawāʿəlt konu ḫolaqomu la-ḥəgaga bərhānāt zaʾarʾayanī ʾUrʾēl zawəʾətu marḥa kwəlu ḫolaqomu

i18n.en: These are the leaders of the days; they are the reckoning of the laws of the luminaries, which Uriel showed me — he who is the leader of all their reckonings.

notes.official: **Closing colophon — Uriel as leader of all reckonings.** This verse closes the lunar-treatise (chs 78-79) with a colophon-style attribution: Uriel as the leader (*marḥa*) of all the reckonings of the laws of the luminaries. The verse restates Uriel's portfolio established at 1 En 72:1 (the opening of the Astronomical Book) and reaffirmed at 1 En 75:3 + 82:7. The closing colophon establishes a literary inclusio bracketing the Astronomical Book's astronomical-and-calendrical content within Uriel's cosmic-administrative-authority. See central entry `uriel-angel-over-luminaries-1-enoch-72-79-82-cross-corpus`.
